title: Melee Assimilation
summary: Melee Assimilation   is a Melee Arcane Enhancement that increases Heavy Attack damage and restores Shields on Heavy Attack kills for 20 seconds after the user's Shields break.
extract:
Melee Assimilation   is a Melee Arcane Enhancement that increases Heavy Attack damage and restores Shields on Heavy Attack kills for 20 seconds after the user's Shields break.

Effects

Acquisition

All drop rates data is obtained from DE's official drop tables stored on Module:DropTables/data.
See Mission Rewards#Standard Missions for definitions on reward table rotations.
For more detailed definitions and information,
visit here.
Can be bought from Hunhow at Pontis Tower for 10  Emerald Talent and 10  Crimson Talent

Notes
Melee Damage bonus is additive to mods like  Pressure Point.
Does generate shields on heavy slams kills.
Shields gained is per enemy killed and therefore can generate full shields with 4 kills in a single heavy attack.
Special Heavy attacks that trigger shield generation on kill:
 Syam heavy attacks wave.
Detonation of Glaive throws (does not apply to kills from direct hits).
Gunblade heavy attacks projeciles.
 Tenet Agendus heavy attacks projectiles.
 Tenet Grigori heavy slide attack projectiles.
 Wolf Sledge detonation on throw.
 Argo & Vel heavy attack glaive and its kills with ricochet.
 Edun thrown heavy attack direct hits (does not trigger off explosion).
 Tak & Lug heavy attack explosion.
 Ceramic Dagger heavy attack projectile explosions (does not trigger off direct hit kills).
Only regenerates shields on kills from direct heavy attack damage similar to  Exodia Brave.
This in practice means it does not trigger from status damage caused by heavy attacks.
Scales off of maximum shields.
Does not generate overshields.
Does trigger from shield break caused by  Empowered Blades.
Does trigger on mission start for builds using  Arcane Persistence but cannot refresh.
Does not trigger off Operator/Drifter shield break.
Only applies to the melee weapon with the arcane equipped.
This in practice means you cannot equip this arcane on an Exalted Weapon and have it trigger on the equipped melee weapon that isn’t using this arcane.
If equipped on an Exalted Weapon, the effect will only generate shields if triggered while the Exalted Weapon is active when shield break occurs.
Contrarily, if used on the equipped melee and shield break occurs while having an Exalted Weapon active, then deactivating the Exalted Weapon and using equipped melee will trigger shield generation on heavy kill within the buff window. This is independent of whether both weapons have this arcane or just the equipped melee weapon.
